content.headline: Northwind Retail signs three-year contract and Contoso migration goes live early
content.intro: This week brings a significant new contract win with Northwind Retail, an early completion of the Contoso migration, and celebrations in the team.

entries.text: Priya Shah and Tom Evans signed Northwind Retail to a three-year managed service contract on 22 September, worth about 180 thousand pounds a year, with onboarding starting in October.
The Contoso migration went live on 20 September, two days early, and user training finished on 24 September.
Welcome to Lucy Grey, who joined the service desk on 29 September.
Happy birthday to Dan Wood, who celebrated on 2 October.
Congratulations to Tom Evans on the arrival of his baby, Ava, on 25 September.
Thank you to Sam Patel for covering the service desk over the bank holiday weekend.
Litware Supplies will raise the price of its business laptops by 5 per cent from 1 November, though orders placed before 31 October will keep the current price.
